# Vdoc

> Document management for OpenAPI, Markdown and TXT. Agents read, compare and save through MCP; humans approve and publish. Consumers define how documents are used in their business.

## Agent access

- [MCP setup and tools](https://chnmig.github.io/Vdoc-site/en/mcp-tools): adapter installation, release/beta channels, client configuration and document operations.
